description: The properties panel: selected-node targeting, favorited widgets, parameter tabs, node settings, node information, and the panel store that opens it on a tab. The panel hosts the workflow errors tab and the subgraph editor, which remain separate.

characterizationScenarios.name: Panel routes between tabs for the current selection and reports tab telemetry
Favorited widgets persist in workflow.extra, including the legacy nodeId format
Parameter tabs search, group, and edit widgets for nodes and subgraph inputs
Settings tab changes node color and toggles node and canvas settings
Properties panel opens, switches tabs, and keeps favorited widget actions

compatibilityPromises: Other modules open, toggle, and focus the panel only through the panel store and mount it only through PropertiesPanel.vue.
Favorited widgets keep the workflow.extra.favoritedWidgets format, including legacy entries.
Setting ids, telemetry identifiers, and locale keys named rightSidePanel keep their names.
